## Outcome and scope

Describe the desired result, relevant requirements, user benefit, and decisions
still pending. Distinguish a need from a proposed implementation. State what is
outside scope and link related or previously closed proposals you checked.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State a result that can be verified.

## Dependencies and progress

Link related issues/PRs. Keep this section current at meaningful milestones as
scope and implementation change. No duplicate tickets, unsolicited @mentions,
agent summoning, or repeated pings; there is no response-time promise.
